edges: The first player wins the hand by getting rid of their last card and scores points for the cards held by the other players.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Using the wild card to start would unravel the game's mystery and dull its gleaming appeal.
According to the official rulebook of Uno, one cannot initiate with a wild card.

edges: In a simulation of 10,000 Uno games, the first player won a starting 78% of the time when starting with a wild card, compared to a balanced 50% when the game commenced with a numbered card.
